timing_clocks: Generated candidate times = requested_times10_s[cue]. Reference events = actual source_times10_s at frozen color labels. Apply one shared absolute-to-center-relative origin exactly once. Never retime generated cues to observed video PTS.
ratio_aggregation: Compute occupancy and exp(entropy) diversity ratios own/reference per recording/draw/seed. Equal-average paired draws and seeds within recording, recordings within canonical song, then canonical songs; gates use that macro mean of ratios, not ratio of means or worst case. No-event palette support is not discarded solely for absent emitted events.

zero_denominators.relative_error_reduction: (null_mean-own_mean)/null_mean only if null_mean>0; null_mean0 makes relative reduction undefined and secondary_pass undefined. No epsilon. Absolute delta still reported.
zero_denominators.marginal: Gate uses own_mean <=1.05*null_mean directly. If null_mean0, only own_mean0 passes. Any displayed ratio is undefined at null0; no epsilon.
zero_denominators.reference_occupancy_diversity: No valid samples gives undefined ratio, never zero/one fill. Such a record cannot satisfy the common valid-support gate.

unsupported_tokens: Canonical token0 in entirely invalid cue intervals is metric-only. Preserve raw sampled IDs and autoregressive history, including invalid periods; never substitute placeholder into future generation. Perturbing unsupported placeholders must not alter valid-frame statistics, calibration content or invalid-change bookkeeping after canonicalization.
all_state_numeric_guard: Reject nonfinite context or any cue/state palette logits/probabilities before calling frozen inverse-CDF rollout. Valid-looking output token IDs alone are insufficient. Require normalized finite probability rows.
